title: saomsim: amortized posterior estimation for stochastic actor-oriented models
description:
A batched simulator for stochastic actor-oriented models (SAOMs) and amortized neural posterior estimators trained on it, with the calibration evidence and RSiena comparisons behind them.

An estimator is trained once on a population of simulated panels and then returns a calibrated posterior for a new panel in a fraction of a second, against seconds to hours for a simulation-based fit. Because the SAOM likelihood factorises over periods and the priors are flat on a box, a single two-wave estimator reads a panel of any length by multiplying its per-period posteriors, so the wave count is a property of the data rather than of the instrument.

The archive includes twelve trained estimators covering the network model and the network-behaviour co-evolution model over 20 to 200 actors. Each is documented in MODELS.md with the range of n outside which its readings should not be trusted, its calibration by simulation-based calibration and coverage, and its known weaknesses. The benchmark datasets are not redistributed; fetch scripts obtain them from the studies that collected them.
